name: Celero.io
description:
Celero turns documents, presentations, and PDFs into microsites: shareable web pages with a link and per-page analytics on who opened it and how far they read.
Connect Celero to Claude to publish links without leaving the chat. Give it a PDF, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Design file, video, or image - and back a link that you can share instead of an attachment.
List the microsites in your account and add a new version to an existing microsite, so a link you've already shared stays live and shows the updated content.
Common uses: sharing a finished deck as a trackable link, updating a shared link with new content, and checking what's been published without opening the dashboard.
Sign in with your own Celero account. Any tool that creates or changes content asks for confirmation first.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Celero.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Celero.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.celero.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Celero.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Celero.io provides these MCP tools: create_microsite, create_upload_url, get_conversion, list_microsites, and update_microsite.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Celero.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Celero.io in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Celero.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Celero.io is developed by Celero. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
